data.body: Anti-pattern scan: 0 candidates (the post-merge bump-on-main pattern is unique to merge-to-main-pr.sh; not a generalizable defect). Local-mode preservation verified: direct.sh's new HEAD-subject guard only fires when subject matches '^chore: bump version to v' — direct mode HEAD = merge commit ('Merge ...'), guard does NOT fire. All direct-mode tests GREEN (version-bump 22/0, isolation 5/0, stale-reset 9/0, no-edit-on-main 15/0, mechanical-amend 9/0). Proceeding to commit.
